Act I

Scene VII

M
AJOR VON
 T
ELLHEIM
Maj. T.
Poor, good woman! I must not forget to destroy the bill. (
Takes some papers from his pocketbook and destroys them.
) Who would guarantee that my own wants might not some day tempt me to make use of it?
